title: Kitchen stove and cooktop

parts.label: Stove burner
parts.looks: A gas burner under a metal grate, or a coil or glass ring on an electric cooktop.
parts.abnormal: Something that can burn sitting right next to it.

parts.label: Aerosol can
parts.looks: A metal spray can (cooking spray, cleaner, air freshener).
parts.abnormal: Within about one metre of a burner or oven vent.

parts.label: Paper towels
parts.looks: A roll of paper towels or a pile of towels or rags.

hazards.label: Flammables next to a burner
hazards.threshold: An aerosol can, paper towels, rags or another combustible within about one metre of a burner. A spoken warning, not an emergency, unless there is flame or smoke.

may: Move the can and towels away from the stove.
must_not: Spray an aerosol near a flame.

tour.open: Show me the stove top and the counter around it.

checkpoints.hint: Tilt down so I can see all the burners and the counter on both sides.
